pages.title: mB (Millibuckets)
pages.text:
**mB** means millibuckets: 1000 mB is one bucket of fluid. Create and its add-ons measure fluids this way.\
\
A Spout fills a terracotta bowl with 250 mB of water, and 90 mB of molten steel sets into a Steel Ingot. Goggles show how much a tank holds.
